title: Reading a leak report
hints: Read the report a line at a time: `std::istringstream in{ report }; std::string line; while (std::getline(in, line)) { ... }` (`<sstream>` and `<string>`). A block line contains `} normal block at 0x`; everything you need is between landmarks you can find with `find`: the number between `{` and `}`, the address up to the comma, the size after it.

`std::stoull(text, nullptr, 16)` reads hexadecimal (and `std::stoull(text)` decimal). For the data line, take everything after `"> "` and read it with another `std::istringstream`, one hex pair at a time: `std::string pair; while (bytes >> pair) data.push_back(static_cast<std::uint8_t>(std::stoul(pair, nullptr, 16)));`.
lessonTitle: Leaks and How to Find Them
